# Slidetake

> Write in markdown. Present on a spatial canvas. Record without timeline editing. A markdown file becomes a spatial deck you move through like a map; recording with OBS, every slide is a take, so a fumbled line is retaken on the spot, and Slidetake writes the frame-exact ffmpeg cut, YouTube chapters and description. For developers and technical educators.

Slidetake runs in the browser at https://slidetake.com. It is open source (Apache 2.0): https://github.com/slidetake/slidetake

## Docs

- [Guide](https://slidetake.com/help.md): the full guide as markdown, itself a Slidetake deck (writing decks, opening and sharing, layouts and keys, presenting, recording, camera directives, review and cut, publish pack)
- [Home deck](https://slidetake.com/home.md): the short introduction shown at https://slidetake.com

## Writing a deck for Slidetake

- Ordinary markdown: every heading is a card; a heading branches off the nearest shallower heading above it.
- reveal.js decks (`---` between slides, `--` for vertical ones) open as they are.
- `<!-- steps -->` before a list reveals one item per press.
- Fenced blocks ```dot, ```d2, ```echarts (JSON options) and ```svg render as diagrams, charts and drawings.
- Images: alone fills the card; beside text makes a split card; a list of images is a gallery (a one-at-a-time carousel under <!-- steps -->); several in one paragraph a grid. Alt text is the caption.
- A YouTube link alone on a line embeds the video; the next press plays it.
- Every feature in one deck: https://slidetake.com/examples (source: https://github.com/slidetake/slidetake/blob/main/examples/showcase.md)
- An optional frontmatter block sets deck options: title, brand, duration (e.g. 10m), pip, camera, accent (the deck's colour; Slidetake's own is green).
- `<!-- view: full -->` makes a card fill the whole screen.
- `<!-- camera: full, on -->` inside a slide steps the presenter's camera; `<!-- view: overview -->` pulls back to the map first.

## Opening a deck

- https://slidetake.com/gh/OWNER/REPO/PATH.md opens a file on GitHub (default branch); /gh/OWNER/REPO@BRANCH/PATH.md another branch.
- https://slidetake.com/gist/ID opens a gist.
- https://slidetake.com/?src=URL opens any markdown URL that allows cross-origin reads.
- https://slidetake.com/share#deflate:DATA opens a deck carried inside the link (deflate-raw, base64url).
- https://slidetake.com/new?template=blank (or talk, recording) opens a starting template.

## Editing

Every deck opened is read-only. Typing in one makes the user's working copy at https://slidetake.com/edit, kept in the browser; Save downloads it as markdown and Share copies a link.
